about_the_game:
The dream is an open world third person shooter, set in a simulation of postapocaliptic Barcelona (2033) where players have to survive and farm data tokens . Use your pulse gun to fight against enemy AI, use your sprinting to avoid being caught by the mobs. The more you survive the more data tokens you win for the leaderboard!

5 Crucial Things to Know Before Buying This Hardcore Survival Shooter:

  • No Handholding Aiming System: This game doesn't believe in coddling players with a fancy reticle. You'll have to rely on your raw skill and instincts to land those shots and stay alive. If you're looking for an easy mode, look elsewhere.

  • Relentless Enemies That Never Give Up: In this unforgiving world, the enemies are as tenacious as they are deadly. They'll chase you to the ends of the earth until you put them down for good or they send you to an early grave. There's no rest for the wicked here.

  • Stripped-Down, Adrenaline-Fueled Gameplay: This game cuts out all the fluff and leaves you with the essentials - running and gunning. While there are items scattered throughout the map for those brave enough to explore, the enemy waves are relentless and will test your mettle at every turn.

  • Not For The Faint of Heart: Let's be real, there are plenty of free games out there that might be more polished or have more bells and whistles. But if you're looking for a raw, unapologetic challenge that will push you to your limits, this is the game for you. Casual gamers need not apply.

Think you have what it takes to survive in this brutal world? Then step up and prove it. But don't say we didn't warn you - this game takes no prisoners.

DROP INTO ACTION!

Pulse gun upgrades: discover the secret upgrades and new firing modes for your gun .

Energy chargers: Replenish the energy of your gun.

Data tokens: Activate the farms and get your tokens!
